visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a white lace collar and black top, looks directly at the camera with an expressive, slightly demanding face while holding an orange cushion in a bright indoor studio environment with a white patterned wall. (2) The scene cuts to a first-person POV showing a hand interacting with a smartphone's LINE app chat list, demonstrating the issue of pinned chats being pushed down by newer messages from other pinned users. (3) The woman returns to frame, now pouting and looking frustrated, gesturing with her hands as she demands a more permanent solution for her chat position. (4) A screen recording sequence provides a step-by-step tutorial on the LINE app interface, showing how to navigate to a profile, click the star icon for 'Favorites', and change chat list sorting to prioritize favorites. (5) In the final phase, the woman smiles sweetly at the camera after the tutorial is complete, followed by a dramatic shift to shock and mock anger as she reacts to the person behind the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a comedic tech tutorial explaining how to use the 'Favorite' sorting feature in LINE to ensure a specific chat remains at the very top of the list.
